description: This file defines metrics-related structures and functions for counters in Kubernetes, including Counter, CounterVec, and associated methods for creating, managing, and interacting with Prometheus counters and counter vectors, with support for context and exemplars.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: Internal representation of a Prometheus counter with additional features like lazy initialization and context support.

classes.name: exemplarCounterMetric
classes.description: Wrapper for CounterMetric that adds exemplar labels from context.

classes.name: CounterVec
classes.description: Internal representation of a Prometheus counter vector with lazy initialization and label management.

classes.name: CounterVecWithContext
classes.description: Wrapper for CounterVec that includes context for metric operations.

methods.name: NewCounter
methods.description: Creates a new Counter object with specified options, with lazy metric instantiation.

methods.name: Desc
methods.description: Returns the description of the underlying Prometheus metric.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the metric data into a DTO.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the underlying Prometheus counter to zero.

methods.name: setPrometheusCounter
methods.description: Sets the internal CounterMetric to a new Prometheus counter.

methods.name: DeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Returns the deprecated version of the counter, if any.

methods.name: initializeMetric
methods.description: Creates the actual underlying Prometheus counter.

methods.name: initializeDeprecatedMetric
methods.description: Creates a deprecated version of the counter.

methods.name: WithContext
methods.description: Returns a CounterMetric that includes context for exemplar attachment.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a value to the counter, attaching exemplars if context is valid.

methods.name: Inc
methods.description: Increments the counter by one, attaching exemplars if context is valid.

methods.name: NewCounterVec
methods.description: Creates a new CounterVec with specified options and labels, with lazy instantiation.

methods.name: DeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Returns the deprecated version of the CounterVec, if any.

methods.name: initializeMetric
methods.description: Creates the actual underlying Prometheus CounterVec.

methods.name: initializeDeprecatedMetric
methods.description: Creates a deprecated version of the CounterVec.

methods.name: WithLabelValues
methods.description: Returns a CounterMetric for specific label values, or noop if not registered.

methods.name: With
methods.description: Returns a CounterMetric for a label map, or noop if not registered.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a metric with specific label values.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics in the CounterVec.

methods.name: ResetLabelAllowLists
methods.description: Resets label allow lists, mainly for testing.

methods.name: WithContext
methods.description: Returns a CounterVec with context for further operations.
